conditional: Run only if WS-M5-08 screen passes its unchanged gates. This file declares fresh confirmation before screen results.
workers: Two fresh WorldSense/Cantor workers, each warms both modes then two measured repetitions/policy of all three fixed frames and one text-plan query. First ABBA, second BAAB. Same binary/models/prompts/caps/pixels.
